name: Choose the Dark theme in Claude setup

criteria.other: Anything else: a different onboarding step (login, trust folder, security notes), the picker with the marker on a different option than plain `Dark mode`, the `/theme` command opened inside a normal session, normal conversation or command output that only mentions these words, or a screen where the theme was already chosen and the next step is shown.
criteria.theme_picker: The screen shows `Welcome to Claude Code`, `Let's get started.`, the heading `Choose the text style that looks best with your terminal`, the hint `To change this later, run /theme`, and a list of options `Auto (match terminal)`, `Dark mode`, `Light mode`, `Dark mode (colorblind-friendly)`, `Light mode (colorblind-friendly)`, `Dark mode (ANSI colors only)`, `Light mode (ANSI colors only)`, usually followed by a code diff preview and a `Syntax theme:` line. If a selection marker (`❯` or `✔`) is visible, it is on the plain `Dark mode` line. The picker is still open: nothing after it shows the onboarding moved on.

question.instructions: The text is the screen of a Claude Code terminal. Decide whether it is showing the first-run onboarding theme picker that is still waiting for the user to choose a text style, with Dark mode as the current selection.

trigger: Choose the text style that looks best with your terminal
